text: IMF staff recommends that the authorities adopt a "credible and binding fiscal rule, preferably anchored in a long-term net debt target" [chunk 23]. Staff suggests that this rule "could be operationalized through multi-year net expenditure ceilings" [chunk 23]. Additionally, staff recommends legislating this national fiscal framework and having the MTFSP act as a binding mechanism on spending ceilings over the medium term [chunk 23].
